flags.title: Tracking ID shopnow047c-20 not yet verified against Associates Central
flags.what_we_know: The ID was supplied in the project brief. It is structurally plausible for a US marketplace ID (the '-20' suffix is the standard US marketplace convention), but enrollment and activity could not be confirmed from any official source because Associates Central is account-gated.
flags.what_is_missing: Confirmation from Associates Central (Settings → Account info) that the ID exists, is active, and belongs to this program account.
flags.discovery: Sign in to Associates Central and check the tracked store ID list; confirm in the account settings page.

flags.title: Self-hosted analytics endpoint undecided — events queue locally
flags.what_we_know: The site ships a privacy-preserving event collector (5 defined events). GitHub Pages is static hosting and cannot run the server side of a self-hosted endpoint, so events are queued in the visitor's browser (localStorage, no cookies, no cross-site identifiers) and exportable from the dashboard.
flags.what_is_missing: A hosting decision for the endpoint (see suggestions SG-08 options A/B/C).
flags.discovery: Choose an option on suggestions/index.html (SG-08); then point window.SHOPNOW_CONFIG.analyticsEndpoint at it.

flags.title: Compliance status of the five submitted link.amazon short links — UNRESOLVED
flags.what_we_know: Observation pass 2026-11-20: all five submitted URLs (https://link.amazon/B04G1MEwY, /B02NbDxp3, /B00hJ57DV, /B0c8moW59, /B0f3GKalj) are second-level names under the .amazon gTLD operated by Amazon Registry Services, Inc. [S09]. Four resolved to amazon.com product pages; one (B0c8moW59) hit an Amazon checkpoint interstitial [FLG-004]. NONE of the observed landing URLs contained an Associates tag parameter (tag=shopnow047c-20 absent); landing URLs carried lv=shuf and btn_ref=srctok-… parameters instead. The identifiers embedded in the submitted paths are 9 characters; Amazon's official ASIN definition is 10 characters [S05]; the observed landing ASINs (10 characters) differ from the submitted path identifiers in every observed case. The Operating Agreement requires commission-bearing links to use its special 'tagged' link formats [S01, S03].
flags.what_is_missing: Whether these short links are (a) Associates-generated Special Links carrying shopnow047c-20, (b) something else (e.g., social-shopping share links generated without an Associates tag), and (c) stable destinations. This cannot be determined from outside the account.
flags.discovery: In Associates Central: generate a fresh link per product (SiteStripe 'Get link' or Link Builder), compare destination and confirm the click appears in Reports → 'Links' report; or run one GetItems lookup per intended ASIN once Creators API access is active [S13]. Test ONE link per product; confirm destination AND tracking report before scaling.
flags.no_verdict_rule: No session may claim the supplied short links are valid OR invalid from outside the account. Their exact compliance status is unresolved until G5 is performed.

flags.title: link.amazon/B0c8moW59 destination unresolved (Amazon checkpoint interstitial)
flags.what_we_know: Server-side fetch on 2026-11-20 reached an Amazon 'checkpoint/continue' interstitial ('To continue, please click the Continue shopping button') instead of a product page. No landing ASIN or title was observed for this link. Nothing was inferred to fill the gap.
flags.what_is_missing: The actual destination of the link in a normal browser session.
flags.discovery: Open the URL signed in to a normal Amazon session; record the landing ASIN from the /dp/ URL; then complete the intent record on products/p4.html.

flags.title: Product identity, price, rating and availability data: blank until confirmed from the listing itself
flags.what_we_know: Observed landing page titles were recorded per link (see products.json observation fields), but titles are observations of a redirect target at one point in time — they are not a confirmation that the intended product matches, and no price/rating/spec value was captured from the landing pages' own offer data during the pass.
flags.what_is_missing: Per-ASIN confirmation of title, price, availability and rating from the listing or the Creators API.
flags.discovery: After G5/G6: fill the intent record from the confirmed listing; populate the comparison table only from verified values.
